A principle goal of the carbon dividends plan is to send an economy-wide market signal that will draw more businesses to invest in similar ventures, helping the U.S. to regain its footing as a leader in energy innovation.
The absence of national carbon policy has forced states to take the lead, relying on a combination of regulations and mandates that result in an incomplete solution.
Energy policies in most states provide incentives for solar, wind and a handful of other clean energy technologies.
The carbon dividends plan offers a way forward.

The carbon dividends proposal offers a measured and cost-effective option that relies on sound economic principles and has the added benefit of being good for consumers, jobs, national security and the health of our communities.
